description: Single global tuning row for combat, movement, recovery, chat, Arcade-result and PvE shop/interval behavior. Consumers always take the first row of the loaded GlobalDataTable rather than looking up a row by its Id.

ArcadeResultFallWaitTime.simple: Maximum wait for the defeated character to land in an Arcade result sequence.
ArcadeResultFallWaitTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3.0 seconds. In GameBattleState_10 step 152 the timer accumulates DeltaTime and the state advances when this value is reached, or early once the loser's ground trace reports contact.

ArcadeResultIdleWaitTime.simple: Hold time before the Arcade result screen opens.
ArcadeResultIdleWaitTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.5 seconds. In GameBattleState_10 step 153, after the timer exceeds it the code requests pause 8, stops all 3D sound effects and voices, and advances to step 200 (result screen).

ArcadeResultSpecialAttackWaitTime.simple: Result hold after a special-attack finish in Arcade mode.
ArcadeResultSpecialAttackWaitTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0 seconds. GameBattleState_10 step 151 selects it when BattleManager->StudioByte_A3A != 0xFF; otherwise ArcadeResultWaitTime is used. The state advances early if the Decision key is pressed.

ArcadeResultWaitTime.simple: Default result hold in Arcade mode.
ArcadeResultWaitTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0 seconds. GameBattleState_10 step 151 uses it when BattleManager->StudioByte_A3A == 0xFF, in place of ArcadeResultSpecialAttackWaitTime; Decision input can skip the wait.

Battle_Chat_CoolTime.simple: Per-key cooldown for ordinary battle chat.
Battle_Chat_CoolTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.3 seconds. UGameCharacterChatController::StartCooldown writes both Duration and Remaining of the cooldown entry for the used EGameChatInputKey when the label is not a provocation/respect label.

Battle_Chat_Limit_CoolTime.simple: Lockout applied after the battle-chat volume limit is hit.
Battle_Chat_Limit_CoolTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 4.0 seconds. UGameCharacterChatController::StartCooldown sets LockoutTimer to it when WindowTimer is already running and WindowCount >= Battle_Chat_Limit_Count.

Battle_Chat_Limit_Count.simple: Number of chat messages allowed in one battle-chat window.
Battle_Chat_Limit_Count.technical: float (compared against integer WindowCount), constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 5.0. When WindowTimer > 0 and WindowCount reaches it, StartCooldown arms Battle_Chat_Limit_CoolTime.

Battle_Chat_Limit_Time.simple: Length of the battle-chat counting window.
Battle_Chat_Limit_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 6.0 seconds. StartCooldown initializes WindowTimer to it whenever WindowTimer has expired; subsequent sends in that window accumulate WindowCount.

Battle_Chat_Type_CoolTime.simple: Cooldown for provocation and respect chat types.
Battle_Chat_Type_CoolTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 60.0 seconds. When the sent label is provocation/respect, StartCooldown iterates ChatIds and overwrites Duration/Remaining for every key whose ChatDataTables row also has such a label, instead of using the ordinary Battle_Chat_CoolTime.

BattleResult_Chat_CoolTime.simple: Chat-send timeout in the battle-result chat list.
BattleResult_Chat_CoolTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.5 seconds. UGameChatListWidget::OnChatItemDecided sends the row Id, sets ChatTimeout from this field, then closes the list; positive ChatTimeout disables the list and ticks down in Tick.

BlowImpactRate_Down.simple: Initial impact velocity fraction when a blow launches a character.
BlowImpactRate_Down.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.02. UGameCharacterMovementController::StartBlowLaunch passes Direction * SpeedInterp.GetStart() * this rate into StartImpactEase(DirectionVelocity, BlowImpactTime_Down); StartImpactEase starts EaseVector1A8 with ExpoOut easing.

BlowImpactRate_Knockback.simple: Impact velocity fraction for generic knockback.
BlowImpactRate_Knockback.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.2. Returned by UGameCharacterMovementController::GetKnockbackImpactRate (slot 90); UGameActorMovementController::StartKnockback multiplies the normalized directionSpeed by it and starts EaseVector1A8 over BlowImpactTime_Knockback with ExpoOut easing.

BlowImpactTime_Down.simple: Duration of the initial blow-launch impact ease.
BlowImpactTime_Down.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.2 seconds. Read locally in UGameCharacterMovementController::StartBlowLaunch and passed as the Time argument of StartImpactEase.

BlowImpactTime_Knockback.simple: Duration of the generic knockback impact ease.
BlowImpactTime_Knockback.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.2 seconds. Returned by UGameCharacterMovementController::GetKnockbackImpactTime (slot 91) and used as ImpactTime for EaseVector1A8 in UGameActorMovementController::StartKnockback.

BlowSpin_DamageGravity.simple: Gravity override for BlowSpin launch actions.
BlowSpin_DamageGravity.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 45.0. FGameCharacterAction_BlowSpin::GetLaunchGravity returns this value when it is positive; when <= 0 it falls back to the action request's DamageGravity. Start passes the result to StartBlowLaunch, which also uses it to build the fall curve.

Chase_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_End.simple: Cursed-energy recovery rate at the end of a chase.
Chase_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_End.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.2. UGameCharacterStatusController::GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate interpolates Start -> End with Alpha when ChaseElapsedTime >= Chase_Time; if that branch did not run, the escape branch uses Escape_Time and the same formula with the escape Start/End rates. The reconstructed code forms Alpha from the corresponding max time: 1.0f when it is > 0, otherwise elapsed / max. With the shipped positive maxima, the branch's End rate is selected once its threshold is met.

Chase_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_Start.simple: Cursed-energy recovery rate at the start of a chase.
Chase_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_Start.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0. Used as the interpolation base in UGameCharacterStatusController::GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate after Chase_Time has elapsed; the rate is adjusted afterwards by CP_090_Passive and other buff/debuff cases.

Chase_DashGaugeConsumeRate.simple: Dash-gauge consumption multiplier when dashing toward a target.
Chase_DashGaugeConsumeRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0. FGameCharacterAction_DashBase::GetDashGaugeConsumeRate and GetDashGaugeConsumeRateByOwnerForward pass it as ChaseRate to GetChaseEscapeRate; inside the chase angle the result is Angle/Chase_Forward_Angle * (1-ChaseRate) + ChaseRate. No target means the multiplier is 1.

Chase_Forward_Angle.simple: Forward cone half-angle used to detect chasing.
Chase_Forward_Angle.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 45.0 degrees. After the valid-target/CanChaseOrEscape and optional stick-deadzone gates, FGameCharacterAction::IsChaseDirection (slot 77) returns angle(facing, camera forward) <= this value; FGameCharacterAction_DashBase::GetChaseEscapeRate also uses it as the denominator when interpolating the chase dash-gauge cost.

Chase_Time.simple: Time before chase recovery-rate interpolation starts.
Chase_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.25 seconds. In UGameCharacterStatusController::GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate the chase interpolation branch runs only when ChaseElapsedTime >= this value, before testing Escape_Time.

Chase_Time_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0 seconds. UGameCharacterStatusController::Tick saturates ChaseElapsedTime at this value while the owner is chasing; GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate also tests > 0 when forming the interpolation Alpha (reconstructed code sets Alpha to 1 in that case).

DamageGravity.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 30.0. FStudioBattleSystem2E0::ApplyDamageReactionSpeed uses DamageRow->DamageGravity when it is > 0 and otherwise this value, storing it in FGameCharacterActionRequest.DamageGravity; shikigami damage uses the same fallback before PushDamageAction.

DamageSpeed_Blend_Exp.simple: Blend exponent for the global damage-speed interpolation.
DamageSpeed_Blend_Exp.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0. Passed as BlendExp to FGameFloatEaseInterpolator::Start in ApplyDamageReactionSpeed and in the shikigami damage reaction path, alongside the mapped DamageSpeed_EasingType and the final blend argument 2. Only used when both damage-row speed endpoints are <= 0.

DamageSpeed_EasingType.simple: Easing used for the global damage-speed interpolation.
DamageSpeed_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType, constructor default None; exported DEFAULT value EGameEasingType::None. ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc maps EaseIn/EaseOut/EaseInOut directly and maps None/Invalid to EEasingFunc::EaseOut. It is selected only when the damage row's own start and end speeds are both <= 0.

DamageSpeed_End.simple: Final damage-speed scale when the damage row has no speed curve.
DamageSpeed_End.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1000.0. Multiplied by Receiver->GetDamageSpeedScale(Row) to form the interpolator's To value in ApplyDamageReactionSpeed and in the shikigami push-damage path; used when DamageRow->DamageSpeed_Start and _End are both <= 0.

DamageSpeed_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the global damage-speed interpolation.
DamageSpeed_InterpolateTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.5 seconds. Passed as InterpolateTime to FGameFloatEaseInterpolator::Start in both global fallback branches (character and shikigami damage reactions).

DamageSpeed_Start.simple: Initial damage-speed scale when the damage row has no speed curve.
DamageSpeed_Start.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3000.0. Multiplied by Receiver->GetDamageSpeedScale(Row) to form the interpolator's From value in ApplyDamageReactionSpeed and the shikigami push-damage path whenever the damage row's own start/end speeds are both <= 0.

DashAirFall_Speed_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3000.0 (speed magnitude). BuildFallCurve receives it as MaxFallSpeed, so the generated curve bottoms out at -this value (and stops after 10 seconds of 1/60 steps). Used for character air-dash mode 7 and shikigami air dash.

Dead_Time.simple: Minimum down-recovery delay after a knockout.
Dead_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 4.0 seconds. FGameCharacterAction_DownBase::CanFinishDownRecovery returns false while a defeated owner with StatusController.Setup.Byte4D == 1 has elapsed < Dead_Time (no ActionControllerSlot181(0) override).

Down_Time_Max.simple: Upper bound of the downed-state recovery window.
Down_Time_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0 seconds. FGameCharacterAction_DownBase::CanFinishDownRecovery adds Owner->GetDownTimeOffset(); once ActionElapsedTime >= Min+offset it uses stick input to decide early recovery, and at >= Max+offset it recovers unconditionally. CN_080's ShouldFinishDown comment also names it as the bound, though that reconstructed body reads Down_Time_Min.

Down_Time_Min.simple: Lower bound of the downed-state recovery window.
Down_Time_Min.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.5 seconds. CanFinishDownRecovery compares ActionElapsedTime against Down_Time_Min + Owner->GetDownTimeOffset(); FCN_080_DownAction::ShouldFinishDown also returns elapsed < this value for a non-defeated owner.

DownFall_Speed_Max.simple: Terminal fall speed for blow/wall/ground bound and shikigami down states.
DownFall_Speed_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 5000.0 (speed magnitude). BuildFallCurve receives it as MaxFallSpeed in StartBlowLaunch, StartWallBound, StartGroundBound and FGameShikigamiDownAction::Start, capping the generated downward velocity at -this value.

DownValue_Recover_Time.simple: Recovery time for the down value outside large-character mode.
DownValue_Recover_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0 second. UGameCharacterStatusController::RestartDownValueRecover assigns it to DownRecoverTime unless the value is already at maximum or owner slot 146 selects the large-character path, which instead uses BaseParameterRow->LargeCharacterDownRecoverTime.

Escape_Back_Angle.simple: Rear cone half-angle used to detect escaping.
Escape_Back_Angle.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 45.0 degrees. After the same valid-target/CanChaseOrEscape and optional stick-deadzone gates, FGameCharacterAction::IsEscapeDirection returns 180 - angle(facing, camera forward) <= this value. Dash gauge interpolation uses BackAngle / Escape_Back_Angle * (1-EscapeRate) + EscapeRate when in the rear cone; without a valid target GetChaseEscapeRate returns 1.

Escape_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_End.simple: Cursed-energy recovery rate at the end of an escape.
Escape_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_End.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0. Used in the Escape_Time interpolation branch of UGameCharacterStatusController::GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate (End - Start) * Alpha + Start.

Escape_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_Star.simple: Cursed-energy recovery rate at the start of an escape.
Escape_CursedEnergyGaugeRecoverRate_Star.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0. Used as the interpolation base in the Escape_Time branch of UGameCharacterStatusController::GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate, only when the chase branch did not run.

Escape_DashGaugeConsumeRate.simple: Dash-gauge consumption multiplier when dashing away from a target.
Escape_DashGaugeConsumeRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.25. Passed as EscapeRate to GetChaseEscapeRate from both dash-rate query paths; within the rear cone the multiplier is BackAngle / Escape_Back_Angle * (1-EscapeRate) + EscapeRate.

Escape_Time.simple: Time before escape recovery-rate interpolation starts.
Escape_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.5 seconds. In GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate the escape branch is evaluated only if the chase branch did not run and EscapeElapsedTime >= this value.

Escape_Time_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0 seconds. UGameCharacterStatusController::Tick saturates EscapeElapsedTime at it while the owner is escaping; GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate uses it to form the escape Alpha (the reconstructed branch assigns 1 when the max is > 0).

FixedPhrase_CoolTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.2 seconds. No reconstructed C++ site reads this member by name, and no cited source attributes a global-row offset read to it. The two transcribed writers of UGameCommonChatListWidget::ChatCooldownTimer_568 (fixed-phrase and stamp sends) both assign VisualLobby_FixedPhrase_DisplayTime; the header's NEED-PROBE comment saying that writer is not transcribed is stale. Any connection between this field and that cooldown remains unproven.

GroundBoundSlowRate.simple: Actor time-dilation rate applied after a ground-bound impact.
GroundBoundSlowRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0. FGameCharacterAction_Down/GroundBound start stores it in Rate188, replacing values <= 0 with 0.0001f. The bound Tick applies SetActorTimeDilation(Owner, Rate188) after Wall/GroundBoundSlowStartTime elapses and keeps the dilation for Wall/GroundBoundSlowTime divided by Rate188 before clearing it.

GroundBoundSlowStartTime.simple: Delay before ground-bound time dilation starts.
GroundBoundSlowStartTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0 second. Read into Timer180 when a ground bound begins; Tick decrements it by DeltaTime and applies GroundBoundSlowRate only after it reaches zero.

GroundBoundSlowTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.0 seconds. Read into Time184 on ground-bound start; after the start delay, Rate188 is applied and Timer180 is reset to Time184, then decremented by DeltaTime / Rate188 before AddActor418 restores normal timing.

GroundBoundSpeedDecTime.simple: Duration over which ground-bound horizontal speed decays to zero.
GroundBoundSpeedDecTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0 seconds. UGameCharacterMovementController::StartGroundBound first multiplies CurrentMoveSpeed by GroundBoundSpeedRate, then starts FloatInterp470 from that speed to zero over this time with the interpolator's existing ease type and blend exponent 2.

GroundBoundSpeedRate.simple: Instant horizontal speed multiplier on ground bound.
GroundBoundSpeedRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.4. UGameCharacterMovementController::StartGroundBound sets MoveState.CurrentMoveSpeed = this value * previous CurrentMoveSpeed before starting the decay interpolation.

ID.technical: FName Id, constructed as NAME_None; the sole exported row is named DEFAULT. All traced consumers call AGameBattleManager::FirstGlobalRow(GlobalDataTables), which enumerates table row names and FindRow<FGameDataTableRow_Global> on the first one, or use named helpers that do the same. No traced consumer dereferences the Id member itself.

Invincible_Dead_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3.0 seconds. Applied as collision lock 7 (true) by blow and damage DownEnd paths and by FCP_180_BounceUp::End; shikigami DownEnd applies lock 5 when bGetupLock is true.

Invincible_Getup_Time.simple: Invincibility lock duration while getting up.
Invincible_Getup_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.5 seconds. Applied as collision lock 5 by FGameCharacterAction_Blow down-end and FCN_230_ExtraAttack_2::FinishAttackEffects; shikigami DownEnd uses collision lock 4 for the same duration.

JumpFall_Speed_Max.simple: Terminal fall speed for jumps and ordinary falling.
JumpFall_Speed_Max.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3000.0 (speed magnitude). Passed as BuildFallCurve MaxFallSpeed for jump/fall move modes, bounce-up, dash-homing and follow-ground states, plus shikigami jump/fall paths; the generated curve is capped at -this value.

JustGuard_HitSlow_Attacker.simple: Attacker slowdown rate on a successful just guard.
JustGuard_HitSlow_Attacker.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.01. In the just-guard branch of damage handling, non-projectile hits read it only when the attacker's GetOverrideJustGuardHitSlowAttacker() returns < 0; the result is passed with the slow time and attacker hit-slow priority to RequestTimeDilation for the instigator.

JustGuard_HitSlow_Receiver.simple: Receiver slowdown rate on a successful just guard.
JustGuard_HitSlow_Receiver.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.05. Passed unconditionally with JustGuard_HitSlow_Time_Receiver to TimeManager->RequestTimeDilation(Receiver, ..., 0, false, false) in the just-guard branch, after any attacker slowdown.

JustGuard_HitSlow_Time_Attacker.simple: Attacker slowdown duration on a successful just guard.
JustGuard_HitSlow_Time_Attacker.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.6 seconds. Used for non-projectile hits when the attacker's GetOverrideJustGuardHitSlowTimeAttacker() is < 0; paired with the attacker slowdown rate and hit-slow priority in RequestTimeDilation.

JustGuard_HitSlow_Time_Receiver.simple: Receiver slowdown duration on a successful just guard.
JustGuard_HitSlow_Time_Receiver.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.35 seconds. Passed as the time argument of RequestTimeDilation for the receiver alongside JustGuard_HitSlow_Receiver.

JustGuard_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.1 seconds. FGameCharacterAction_JustGuard::Tick ends the action when elapsed >= it; UGameCharacterStatusController::IsInJustGuardWindow returns false when bJustGuardWindowOpen is 0 and true while JustGuardWindowElapsed <= it.

LargeCharacterDamageDirection_Pitch.simple: Vertical hit-direction correction for defeated large characters.
LargeCharacterDamageDirection_Pitch.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 30.0 degrees. ApplyDamageReactionSpeed selects the large-character branch on receiver action slot 146; if defeated, it zeroes HitDirection.Z, normalizes, builds a Y axis from the horizontal direction, then rotates HitDirection by -this pitch around that axis.

LargeCharacterDamageGravity.simple: Launch gravity override for large-character damage reactions.
LargeCharacterDamageGravity.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 60.0. In ApplyDamageReactionSpeed, a receiver with action slot 146 == 1 has Request.DamageGravity overwritten with this value regardless of the damage row's own gravity; defeated status only gates the separate hit-direction pitch correction.

LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_Blend_Exp.simple: Blend exponent for large-character damage-speed interpolation.
LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_Blend_Exp.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.0. Passed with the mapped LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_EasingType and final blend argument 2 to Request.Interp38.Start in the receiver slot 146 branch of ApplyDamageReactionSpeed.

LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType, constructor default None; exported DEFAULT value EGameEasingType::None. Mapped by ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc in the receiver slot 146 branch; None/Invalid resolve to EEasingFunc::EaseOut.

LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_End.simple: Final damage-speed scale for large characters.
LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_End.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1000.0. Passed as the To argument of Request.Interp38.Start in the large-character branch of ApplyDamageReactionSpeed, without the receiver damage-speed scale multiplication used in the normal branch.

LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_InterpolateTim.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.5 seconds. Passed as InterpolateTime to Request.Interp38.Start in the receiver slot 146 branch.

LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_Start.simple: Initial damage-speed scale for large characters.
LargeCharacterDamageSpeed_Start.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3000.0. Passed as the From argument of Request.Interp38.Start in the receiver slot 146 branch of ApplyDamageReactionSpeed.

LinkCombo_CoolTime.simple: Cooldown started after a link combo.
LinkCombo_CoolTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3.5 seconds. UGameCharacterStatusController::StartLinkComboCoolTime copies it into LinkComboCoolTime.

LinkCombo_CursedEnergyExp_Add.simple: Cursed-energy gauge gain per link-combo level step.
LinkCombo_CursedEnergyExp_Add.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 15.0. AddLinkComboCursedEnergy computes trunc(this * 0.01f * (Threshold(Level+1) - Threshold(Level))) with the level upper-clamped to 3 (FMath::Min), then multiplies by the LinkComboCursedEnergyExpIncreaseItem buff rate and the character row's LinkComboCursedEnergyExpRate, adds equipment and binding-vow link-combo effects, and applies the result to the gauge.

PvECostHealNum.simple: Number of force-gauge points restored by a PvE full recovery purchase.
PvECostHealNum.technical: int32, constructor default 0; exported DEFAULT value 1. UseForceRecovery spends PvECostHealPoint heal points, adds this to the previous-battle snapshot's team gauge for index 0 and clamps to the computed maximum; the recovery UI highlights this many gauge icons when the cost button is focused.

PvECostHealPoint.simple: Heal-point price of a PvE full recovery purchase.
PvECostHealPoint.technical: int32, constructor default 0; exported DEFAULT value 3. Read by UseForceRecovery to spend points, by the recovery select widget to set the button's necessary point count, and to gate bForceRecoveryAvailable on both current < maximum force gauge and enough heal points.

PvELargeHPHealPoint.simple: Heal-point price of a large HP recovery.
PvELargeHPHealPoint.technical: int32, constructor default 0; exported DEFAULT value 2. GamePhase_IntervalPvE::UseLargeHeal spends it from the paying character; the recovery character widget selects between small and large prices based on bLargeHeal and displays it on the heal button.

PvELargeHPHealRate.simple: Fraction of maximum HP restored by a large heal.
PvELargeHPHealRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.5. RestoreCharacterHitPoint is called with it after paying PvELargeHPHealPoint; the widget preview computes floor(Maximum * rate + 0.5f) and clamps the result to Maximum.

PvESmallHPHealPoint.simple: Heal-point price of a small HP recovery.
PvESmallHPHealPoint.technical: int32, constructor default 0; exported DEFAULT value 1. GamePhase_IntervalPvE::UseSmallHeal spends it from the paying character; the recovery character widget uses it for the small-heal button cost.

PvESmallHPHealRate.simple: Fraction of maximum HP restored by a small heal.
PvESmallHPHealRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.2. RestoreCharacterHitPoint is called with it after paying PvESmallHPHealPoint; the UI also uses it for the small-heal preview and as the extra condition when enabling a large heal (Rate + small rate < 1).

ReceiveComboCount_Recover_Time.simple: Reset interval for the received-hit combo counter.
ReceiveComboCount_Recover_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 2.5 seconds. Every increment of ReceiveComboCount in UGameCharacterStatusController resets ReceiveComboRecoverTime from this field; the counter feeds GetReceivedComboCount used in the GlobalCorrect combo scaling.

ShopLotteryPrice.technical: int32, constructor default 0; exported DEFAULT value 5000. GameShopLottery_Price returns it unguarded; the widget inserts it into text parameter VALUE, calls MoneyCount->SetPurchasePrice, and checks DrawCount * price against UserMoney before allowing a draw.

TagComboDamageInvincibleTime.simple: Invincibility interval at the start of tag-combo damage.
TagComboDamageInvincibleTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.26 seconds. Blow, projection-sorcery and restraint tag-combo flows request owner time dilation with SlowRate/SlowTime and set collision lock 4 for this duration; once the lock expires the battle widget effect duration is set to TagComboDamageSlowTime - this value.

TagComboDamageSlowRate.simple: Owner time-dilation rate during tag-combo damage.
TagComboDamageSlowRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.3. When owner CustomTimeDilation == 1, Blow/ProjectionSorcery/Restraint tag-combo phases call TimeManager->RequestTimeDilation(owner, this rate, TagComboDamageSlowTime, 0, false, false) and arm collision lock 4 for TagComboDamageInvincibleTime.

TagComboDamageSlowTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3.0 seconds. Used as the RequestTimeDilation time with TagComboDamageSlowRate, and after the invincibility lock expires its difference with TagComboDamageInvincibleTime is passed to UGameBattleWidget::SetTagComboDamageEffectDuration.

TimeLimit.simple: Default battle time limits in seconds, ordered from primary to alternate choice.
TimeLimit.technical: TArray<float>; constructor leaves it empty; exported DEFAULT values [300.0, 180.0] seconds. Base, free and mission-battle getters use index 0 only when their explicit request or wave time is <= 0; the main-menu Visual Lobby host path instead writes index 0 unconditionally. The Visual Lobby rule widget always offers index 0 as its default option and offers index 1 only when Num() >= 2, then adds an infinite option; the free-battle rule list adds every array entry, then an infinite option. The VsEnemy interval widget substitutes index 0 only when its local TimeLimit is zero and Num() > 0. Most battle-phase getters and the main-menu assignment index [0] without a length check.

UnlimitedVoidReceive_Time.simple: Duration of the Unlimited Void receive/adaptation action.
UnlimitedVoidReceive_Time.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 3.6 seconds. FGameCharacterAction_UnlimitedVoidReceive::Tick sets its completion flag when this value < Elapsed; FCN_240_UnlimitedVoidReceive::Start also calls Controller->BeginAdaptation with it.

VisualLobby_FixedPhrase_DisplayTime.simple: Chat cooldown after sending a fixed phrase or stamp in the Visual Lobby.
VisualLobby_FixedPhrase_DisplayTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 5.0 seconds. UGameCommonChatListWidget::OnChatItemDecided and OnStampItemDecided send the message and assign this to ChatCooldownTimer_568; positive timer disables the chat window and ticks down.

WallBoundSlowRate.simple: Actor time-dilation rate after a wall-bound impact.
WallBoundSlowRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.0. FGameCharacterAction_WallBound start stores it in Rate188 (values <= 0 become 0.0001f); the bound Tick applies it with SetActorTimeDilation after WallBoundSlowStartTime and holds it for WallBoundSlowTime / Rate188. UGameWarpLocation also multiplies it by WallBoundSpeedRate to size a push-out when the target capsule is wider than the hit distance.

WallBoundSlowStartTime.simple: Delay before wall-bound time dilation starts.
WallBoundSlowStartTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.01 seconds. Stored in Timer180 when a wall bound begins; Tick decrements it by DeltaTime before applying WallBoundSlowRate.

WallBoundSlowTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.0 seconds. Stored in Time184 on wall-bound start; after the start delay, WallBoundSlowRate is applied and Timer180 resets to this value, then decrements by DeltaTime / Rate188 before normal timing is restored.

WallBoundSpeedDecTime.simple: Duration over which wall-bound horizontal speed decays to zero.
WallBoundSpeedDecTime.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 1.4 seconds. StartWallBound multiplies speed by WallBoundSpeedRate, then starts FloatInterp470 from that speed to zero over this time using the interpolator's ease type with blend exponent 2.

WallBoundSpeedRate.simple: Instant horizontal speed multiplier on wall bound.
WallBoundSpeedRate.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f; exported DEFAULT value 0.4. StartWallBound multiplies MoveState.CurrentMoveSpeed by it before the decay interpolation; UGameWarpLocation also multiplies it by WallBoundSlowRate and the reach distance when pushing out of a wide target capsule.

notes: The retail export contains one row named DEFAULT; its ImportKeyField is Id. AGameDataTableManager::StartInitialLoading requests GlobalDataTable by that asset name, Tick resolves it into GlobalDataTables (+0x2E0), and AGameBattleManager::FirstGlobalRow returns the first row of the first non-empty table. No traced consumer selects a row by the Id member.
FirstGlobalRow returns nullptr when no loaded table yields a row; the reconstructed consumers shown here dereference the result without a null check, so no missing-row fallback is established.

The file does not assert retail source-level names for reconstructed members; comments in the source preserve retail RVAs and byte offsets (for example FirstGlobalRow 0x10174f0, row +0x2C JumpFall_Speed_Max and +0x15C ShopLotteryPrice). These are static evidence from locally reconstructed code.

Constructor defaults in GameDataTableRow_Global.cpp are mostly 0.0f/0; the DEFAULT export supplies the shipped tuning values quoted in this page. Values are seconds for timers, degrees for angles, and speed magnitudes for fall caps unless stated otherwise.
Reconstructed C++ and the supplied export are the only evidence used here. Partial Content, Blueprint and uncooked consumers cannot be ruled out.

usages.detail: Resolves the loaded GlobalDataTable into GlobalDataTables after all loaders complete.
FirstGlobalRow provides the shared row to every damage, fall-curve, bound and result consumer that calls it.
ApplyDamageReactionSpeed reads large-character or fallback damage-speed/gravity fields into the action request.
Just-guard handling reads attacker and receiver slowdown rates and durations.
Cursed-energy recover rate interpolates chase/escape values after their respective time thresholds.
Blow launch builds the fall curve and starts the initial ExpoOut impact ease.
Tag-combo damage flow requests owner time dilation and an invincibility collision lock, then sets the battle widget effect duration.
Arcade result sequence uses the four result wait times to gate state advancement.
Battle chat cooldown, type cooldown and volume-limit values are read from the first global row.
Wall and ground bound reads speed multipliers, decay times, fall cap and the bound impact timings.
Bound actions load slow start, duration and rate; Tick applies and clears actor time dilation.
Link-combo cursed-energy gain and cooldown are derived from the global row.
PvE interval heals consume configured heal points and restore HP/force by configured rates and amounts.
Shop lottery price helper is used for display, purchase price and affordability checks.
TimeLimit entries populate Visual Lobby match-rule options and the default selection.
Visual Lobby fixed-phrase and stamp sends arm the shared chat cooldown timer.
Wall-bound speed and slow rates size the push-out when a target capsule is wider than the trace distance.
Battle-result chat sends restart ChatTimeout from BattleResult_Chat_CoolTime.
Chase/escape rates and angle thresholds scale dash-gauge consumption; GetChaseEscapeRate returns 1 without a valid target.
